name: Dandy Blend Instant Herbal Beverage with Dandelion (Coffee Alternative)
whyItWorks: Water-soluble extract of roasted barley, rye, dandelion, and chicory roots. Because it is a water extract, all gluten proteins and harsh insolubles are eliminated (<5 ppm gluten). Delivers a rich coffee flavor with zero acidity and zero caffeine.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stir 1 rounded teaspoon into hot water or warm almond milk. Dissolves instantly without brewing or grounds.
